The company that produces Crystal Light lemonade powder mix is The Kraft Heinz Company. As of the information available, the company with the largest equity stake in The Kraft Heinz Company is Berkshire Hathaway, holding a 27% stake.

The CEO of Berkshire Hathaway as of April 2025 is Greg Abel.
